verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships an official, first-party MCP server. Through it, AI assistants can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options and release workflows on the user's behalf, so a user can operate the product in natural language. That natural-language layer comes from the user's external AI assistant, though; nothing shows a built-in natural-language interface in Flagsmith itself. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documented example prompts or workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf
The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
